sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach are on a five-game winning streak and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, while Alsager Town are struggling near the foot of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form having won only once in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture where the visitors will be looking to close the gap on Sandbach; Stafford are unbeaten in their last two games. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a top-half clash between two in-form sides, with Bridgnorth having recovered from a recent loss with wins in their last four outings. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in another competitive mid-table fixture. In the chasing pack, Bilston Town host Foley Meir while Barnton travel to Shawbury United, with both matches involving teams around the mid-table zone. Lower down the table, Brereton Social face Widnes Town—a basement-battle between two struggling sides—while New Mills host Market Drayton Town and Crewe visit Allscott Heath as the bottom half seek crucial points. Telford Town travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads in a match between two of the division's poorest-performing teams.
